description: Dataset-level catalog: what exists, where it lives, what it can/can't support. No raw third-party data committed.

datasets.access: metadata only in repo; download separately under repository terms
datasets.name: Mendeley sucker rod failure data (DOI 10.17632/42jnkpp5tv.1)
datasets.why_relevant: Only openly catalogued rod/tubing failure dataset found; directly relevant to future failure modeling.

datasets.access: open data platform (Equinor/Databricks); NOT in repo
datasets.name: Equinor Volve open field data (2008-2016)
datasets.why_relevant: Most complete open production time-series release; teaches pipeline shapes, not Baghewala physics.

datasets.access: papers only; no raw cards in repo
datasets.name: SRP dynamometer-card literature (Mossoro, China, methods repo)
datasets.why_relevant: Establishes what SRP failure data looks like and how the field models it.

can_support: feature-matrix shape validation for future ML
datasets.name: Synthetic Baghewala-constrained telemetry (seeded)
datasets.why_relevant: Only granular well-level records available; every record labeled synthetic with generator version + seed.

datasets.access: public aggregate facts in provenance.json; no time series
cannot_support: Attachment of field aggregates to individual wells
datasets.name: Baghewala field evidence (field-level aggregates and context)
datasets.why_relevant: Only Baghewala-specific public evidence class available.

datasets.name: Verified Baghewala well-specific public records (5 publicly verified well records)
datasets.why_relevant: Only verified well-specific Baghewala evidence. Baghewala field contains additional wells; only wells with sufficient publicly verifiable well-specific evidence are represented in this public registry. Well-specific production is sparse (1 range-derived observation for BGW-08).

datasets.name: Values derived from Baghewala source observations (labeled DERIVED)
datasets.why_relevant: Example: BGW-08 85 BOPD is the arithmetic midpoint of the reported 80-90 BOPD range (derivation recorded, raw range recoverable). Derived values must never be presented as raw measurements.

telemetry_availability_statement: Public Baghewala data includes field-level information and 5 publicly verified well records (BGW-01, BGW-04, BGW-08, BGW-17, BGW-40; see project/data/public/baghewala_well_coverage.json). Complete continuous well-by-well SCADA telemetry was not found publicly: no per-well continuous SPM/VFD/pressure/temperature streams were found. Well-specific production is sparse (one reported 80-90 BOPD range for BGW-08, stored as derived midpoint 85 BOPD). Field-level values must never be attached to individual wells. Synthetic telemetry must never be represented as measured Baghewala telemetry.

public_well_coverage.note: Baghewala field contains additional wells; only wells with sufficient publicly verifiable well-specific evidence are represented in this public registry.

provenance_classes.BAGHEWALA_FIELD: Measured/reported specifically at Baghewala (field-level aggregates or verified well-specific history).
provenance_classes.BAGHEWALA_WELL_PUBLIC: Logical subset of BAGHEWALA_FIELD: verified well-specific historical/status/CSS/production evidence (dataset baghewala_well_public). Not a separate provenance class in code; scope=WELL_LEVEL distinguishes it.
provenance_classes.PUBLIC_REFERENCE: Legitimate external datasets/methodology references that are NOT Baghewala measurements.
provenance_classes.SYNTHETIC_BAGHEWALA: Generated telemetry for demos/testing only; never measured Baghewala data.
provenance_classes.DERIVED: Values calculated from another source observation (e.g. BGW-08 85 BOPD midpoint); raw observation must remain recoverable.
provenance_classes.UNKNOWN: Provenance cannot be established; includes live operator-supplied telemetry via /telemetry/ingest until a source is declared.

integrity_rules: Field-level values must never be attached to individual wells.
Synthetic telemetry must never be represented as measured Baghewala telemetry.
Derived values must never be presented as raw measurements.
Publication dates must never be used as operational event dates.
Public records must never silently become live telemetry.
